pickupReturnChain.waitingBody: The provider will mark the car ready when it's cleaned, fueled, and waiting for you. You'll get a notification the moment it's ready.
pickupReturnChain.pickupCodeBody: The provider has the car ready. Show this code, then confirm when you actually have the keys in hand.
pickupReturnChain.inTripBody: Return the car to the provider on time. When you're back, tap the button below so the provider can inspect and close the trip.
pickupReturnChain.returnCodeBody: The provider enters this code to confirm they've received the car back in good condition. The trip closes once they do.
pickupReturnChain.completedBody: Thanks for renting with us. Your security deposit is being released, and a receipt will land in your inbox shortly.
pickupReturnChain.confirmPickupHint: Enter the 6-digit code shown above to confirm you have the vehicle. Do this only when the car is with you.
pickupReturnChain.markReturnedHint: Only do this when the car is physically with the provider. You'll get a 6-digit code to give them so they can close out the trip.
pickupReturnChain.toastReturnRecordedDetail: Show the return code to the provider to complete.
